answer: Driving-competence research for WANTED (2026-09-02), sourced from the LOCAL pinned SHVDN docs (bridge/lib/Docs/ScriptHookVDotNet3.xml), SHVDN main source, and citizenfx/natives. HEADLINE FINDINGS: (1) SHVDN's StartVehicleMission overloads default driveAgainstTraffic=true - we never pass it, a direct cause of head-on crashes; pass false explicitly. (2) Our DrivingStyles.AvoidTraffic is 786468 = DrivingModeAvoidVehiclesReckless, documented as 'doesn't use the brakes at ALL to help with steering' - a crash generator; stop using it as a default. (3) GET_POS_ALONG_GPS_TYPE_ROUTE (0xF3162836C28F9DA5, BOOL(Vector3* result, BOOL bStartAtPlayerPos, float fDistanceAlongRoute, int slotType); eGpsSlotType WAYPOINT=0 RADAR_BLIP=1 DISCRETE=2) samples the game's own GPS route - enable with SET_BLIP_ROUTE, confirm GET_GPS_BLIP_ROUTE_FOUND (0x869DAACBBE9FA006), length GET_GPS_BLIP_ROUTE_LENGTH (0xBBB45C3CF5C8AA85); sample ~150 m ahead and drive to THAT, re-sampling every ~2 s. Turns a straight-line 800 m goto into real road-following. No native returns the full polyline. (4) For tailing a mission vehicle prefer TASK_VEHICLE_MISSION_PED_TARGET (0x9454528DF15D657A) / TASK_VEHICLE_MISSION (0x659427E0EF36BCDE) with missionType=Follow(7) over TASK_VEHICLE_FOLLOW, because only the mission natives expose straightLineDist ('distance at which the AI heads for the target directly instead of following nodes', clamped 255, -1 = default 20) - set 60-100 m for a tail. TASK_VEHICLE_CHASE (0x3C08A8E30363B353) genuinely keeps pace but rams (can fail a mission); tune only while running via SET_TASK_VEHICLE_CHASE_IDEAL_PURSUIT_DISTANCE; cannot be used in a TaskSequence. VehicleMissionType (SHVDN, verified): None=0 Cruise=1 Ram=2 Block=3 GoTo=4 Stop=5 Attack=6 Follow=7 Flee=8 Circle=9 EscortLeft=10 EscortRight=11 EscortRear=12 EscortFront=13 GoToRacing=14 FollowRecording=15 PoliceBehaviour=16 ParkPerpendicular=17 ParkParallel=18 Land=19 LandAndWait=20 Crash=21 PullOver=22 HeliProtect=23. (5) Mid-task tuning works ONLY while the drive task is already running (SHVDN XML is explicit): SET_DRIVE_TASK_CRUISE_SPEED (Ped.DrivingSpeed), SET_DRIVE_TASK_DRIVING_STYLE, SET_DRIVER_AGGRESSIVENESS (Ped.DrivingAggressiveness, 0-1), SET_DRIVER_ABILITY (0xB195FFA8042FC5C3, engine-clamps at 1.0, NO SHVDN wrapper - raw Function.Call). AdjustCruiseSpeedBasedOnRoadSpeed and PreventBackgroundPathfinding only work for MISSION_CRUISE - no-ops on a goto/follow. (6) Anti-stuck without cheating: Vehicle.IsStuckTimerUp(VehicleStuckType.Jammed, ~4500) [OnRoof=0 OnSide=1 HungUp=2 Jammed=3 ResetAll=4], recover with TASK_VEHICLE_TEMP_ACTION (0xC429DCEEB339E129): TA_GO_IN_REVERSE=22, TA_TURN_LEFT_GO_REVERSE=13, TA_TURN_RIGHT_GO_REVERSE=14, TA_ACCELERATE_FAST=23, TA_STRONG_BRAKE=19; then RESET_VEHICLE_STUCK_TIMER(veh, 4) and RE-ISSUE the drive task (temp actions override it). (7) Do not re-issue the drive task every tick - task churn is itself a stall cause; re-issue only when the target moved >~30 m, otherwise use the mid-task setters. JUDGMENT CALLS (not facts): SET_DRIVER_ABILITY(0.8) and aggressiveness 0.5-0.8 are 'a skilled human driver', engine-clamped, and change AI competence not vehicle physics - recommended as a DISCLOSED assist. SET_VEHICLE_ON_GROUND_PROPERLY to self-right a flipped car is a cheat under our rules (a human cannot); get out and find another car. TASK_GO_TO_POINT_ANY_MEANS_EXTRA_PARAMS has a warp-if-stuck parameter that MUST stay -1.0.

facts.claim: SHVDN StartVehicleMission overloads default driveAgainstTraffic = true; VehicleMissionType.Follow = 7; straightLineDist is 'the distance in meters at which the AI switches to heading for the target directly instead of following the nodes', clamped to 255, -1 selects default 20 m

DrivingModeAvoidVehiclesReckless = 786468: 'difference between this and AvoidVehicles is that it doesn't use the brakes at ALL to help with steering'. DrivingModeAvoidVehicles = 786469, StopForVehicles = 786603, StopForVehiclesIgnoreLights = 786475

GET_POS_ALONG_GPS_TYPE_ROUTE 0xF3162836C28F9DA5 BOOL(Vector3* result, BOOL bStartAtPlayerPos, float fDistanceAlongRoute, int slotType); eGpsSlotType {WAYPOINT=0, RADAR_BLIP=1, DISCRETE=2}. Companions: SET_BLIP_ROUTE 0x4F7D8A9BFB0B43E9, SET_NEW_WAYPOINT 0xFE43368D2AA4F2FC, GET_GPS_BLIP_ROUTE_FOUND 0x869DAACBBE9FA006, GET_GPS_BLIP_ROUTE_LENGTH 0xBBB45C3CF5C8AA85. No native returns the full route polyline

Drive-task setters require the task to be ALREADY RUNNING: 'This must be on a Vehicle as a driver and the drive task running on this Ped must be active before setting the value can actually affect'. SET_DRIVER_ABILITY 0xB195FFA8042FC5C3 verifies the value is <= 1.0f and does nothing if greater; SET_DRIVER_AGGRESSIVENESS 0xA731F608CA104E3C range 0.0-1.0

TASK_VEHICLE_TEMP_ACTION 0xC429DCEEB339E129 eTempAction: TA_BRAKE_REVERSE=3, TA_HANDBRAKE_TURN_LEFT=4, TA_HANDBRAKE_TURN_RIGHT=5, TA_TURN_LEFT_GO_REVERSE=13, TA_TURN_RIGHT_GO_REVERSE=14, TA_STRONG_BRAKE=19, TA_GO_IN_REVERSE=22, TA_ACCELERATE_FAST=23. IS_VEHICLE_STUCK_TIMER_UP 0x679BE1DAF71DA874 (p1 0-3, p2 ~1000-10000 ms); RESET_VEHICLE_STUCK_TIMER 0xD7591B0065AFAA7A (4 = clear all); VehicleStuckType {OnRoof=0, OnSide=1, HungUp=2, Jammed=3, ResetAll=4}

Road-node natives: GET_CLOSEST_VEHICLE_NODE 0x240A18690AE96513, GET_NTH_CLOSEST_VEHICLE_NODE_FAVOUR_DIRECTION 0x45905BE8654AE067, GET_VEHICLE_NODE_PROPERTIES 0x0568566ACBB5DEDC (HIGHWAY=1<<6, JUNCTION=1<<7, LEADS_TO_DEAD_END=1<<5). CALCULATE_TRAVEL_DISTANCE_BETWEEN_POINTS 0xADD95C7005C4A197 returns 100000.0 as a failure mode over long distances. GENERATE_DIRECTIONS_TO_COORD 0xF90125F1F79ECDF8 always returns 0; info is in out-params; direction 1 = going wrong way; distToNxJunction is metres x 10

DeepGTAV's default drivingMode is [1074528293, 15.0] - decodes to DrivingModeAvoidVehicles | ForceJoinInRoadDirection at 15 m/s: independent confirmation of a sane AI-driving preset. The wider open-source GTA-V self-driving cluster is CNN screen-scraping + simulated keypresses (abandoned, and contrary to our native-task architecture); no strong prior art exists for 'AI plays missions well using task natives'
